# Runae

> Runae is an AI-assisted Eastern astrology platform that decodes your Chinese birth chart (BaZi / Four Pillars of Destiny) into plain-English insight for self-reflection. Enter your birth date, time, and place to get a free chart preview — your Day Master, Five-Element balance, and personality tendencies — with an optional detailed report. Runae is built for an English-speaking and diaspora audience who want the real BaZi method (not sun-sign horoscopes), framed as a tool for self-understanding rather than fixed fate.

## What Runae does

Runae computes an authentic Four Pillars chart from a deterministic BaZi engine (not guessed by a language model), then uses AI to explain what the chart means in everyday language. The reading covers your Day Master (the core self), the balance of the Five Elements (Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water), your Chinese zodiac animal, and your luck cycles (Da Yun). A short preview is free; a fuller written report is available as a one-time purchase.

## Key terms (Runae's definitions)

- **BaZi (八字), a.k.a. Four Pillars of Destiny**: A Chinese astrology system that maps your birth year, month, day, and hour to eight characters (two per "pillar") drawn from the Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches. Unlike Western astrology's focus on planets, BaZi reads the interaction of the Five Elements in your chart.
- **Day Master (日主)**: The Heavenly Stem of your day pillar — the symbol that represents "you" at the center of the chart. Your Day Master is one of ten types (yin/yang × the five elements, e.g. Yang Wood, Yin Fire) and is the anchor for interpreting personality and relationships.
- **Five Elements (五行)**: Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, Water. BaZi analysis looks at which elements are strong, weak, or missing in your chart to describe tendencies and what brings balance.
- **BaZi vs Western astrology**: Western astrology is built on the positions of the sun, moon, and planets; BaZi is built on the calendar (stems, branches, and elements) at your exact birth time. Same person, different lens — BaZi tends to read as more structural/temperament-based.
- **Chinese zodiac compatibility (the BaZi way)**: Real compatibility in BaZi is read from two full charts and their element interactions, not just matching the two birth-year animals — which is why simple "animal match" tables are often misleading.

## Positioning and honesty

Runae is a tool for self-discovery and entertainment, not deterministic fortune-telling. It does not predict fixed outcomes and does not give medical, legal, or financial advice. Chart facts come from the calculation engine; interpretations are AI-generated and clearly disclosed as such.
